StickyNotes is live in NetSuite (let me know if you don't see it). You can drop a note directly on any record, tag a coworker on it, and keep the conversation attached to the transaction instead of buried in email.
How to add a note
Open any record and look for the StickyNotes menu in the button bar at the top. Pick one of the three colored squares next to New (pink, yellow, or green) to set the priority, type your note, and hit Save.
To send it to someone, type their name in the To field before saving. They will see it when they open the record. Check Public if you want the note visible to everyone rather than just the person you tagged. NOTE- if set up properly they should get an email with a link to the note too.

Adjust your settings
Go to Home > Set Preferences > Custom Preferences and find the StickyNotes section on the right. From there you can change the note size, font size, and posting shortcut key, or turn notes off on record pages entirely if you would rather not see them.

A few notes on good use
Keep notes short and action oriented. Use them for questions and context on a specific record, not as a replacement for official documentation or approvals. If something needs a formal record, it still belongs in the memo field or a case.
Also you can see everything that's "open" via StickyNotes Board - NetSuite (CandyCo, LLC) (accessible also via typing StickyNotes in global search)
